Prince's former manager seeks nearly $5 million for renovated Los Angeles home bought for $2.75 million
stories.summary: Bob Cavallo undertook a significant renovation of a Nichols Canyon home initially intended for a family member. Originally built in 1988, the house underwent extensive updates to cater to contemporary buyers. These enhancements included transforming a dumbwaiter shaft into an elevator for better accessibility. Post-renovation, the property was listed at nearly $5 million. Cavallo's expertise in music management notably shaped his vision for real estate development.

stories.title: New giant bird species identified 17 years after discovery
stories.summary: Researchers have identified a new extinct species of ground-dwelling bird, Megapodius rokusi, from a fossil. This fossil, a leg bone, was discovered in Liang Bua cave on Flores Island, Indonesia. It represents the first megapode fossil found in the region called Wallacea, indicating new insights into ancient bird species. The study suggests that the bird was much larger than today's living relatives.

Texas woman keeps marital home after husband's 50-year sentence for family violence

US commerce secy was sent secret memo on Nvidia CEO’s affair with Chinese spy: Report
stories.summary: US commerce secretary Howard Lutnick had recieved a confidential memo revealing Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang's ties to a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The memo was circulated ahead of President Trump's visit to China in May. Although US officials alerted Trump about Huang’s connections, no action was taken, and Huang was invited on the trip. This situation has raised alarms over Huang's role in shaping AI policies and decisions affecting Nvidia.

stories.title: Indian seafarer injured as projectile hits Liberia-flagged oil tanker in Persian Gulf
57 injured as bus crashes into 31 vehicles in South Korea
‘Unfit to remain in office’: Eisenkot attacks Netanyahu after ‘hateful’ Knesset speech
stories.summary: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after his controversial speech. Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu for his divisive and unfit behavior during the Knesset swearing-in ceremony. Netanyahu continues to advocate for a unity government while rejecting ties with Arab parties. The political landscape remains fragmented with no party holding a clear majority in the Knesset.

stories.title: US army officer arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
stories.summary: A US army officer serving with Nato's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps was arrested near Gloucester in England on suspicion of espionage linked to Russia, British police said. The 41-year-old suspect faces allegations of assisting a foreign intelligence service and obtaining or disclosing protected information. The arrest comes amid growing European concerns over Russian covert operations, sabotage and espionage targeting Nato countries.

stories.title: Nvidia hires top US law firm to investigate affair between CEO Huang and Chinese spy
stories.summary: Nvidia has engaged the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to probe allegations against CEO Jensen Huang, who is implicated in a case involving a suspected Chinese spy named Alice Huang. While Jensen has acknowledged a personal relationship with Alice, he firmly denies any involvement in espionage. The FBI has also launched a separate investigation, but Nvidia reassures all stakeholders that trade secrets and national security remain intact.

stories.title: Parl panel drops NCR air pollution from agenda, Cong’s Maken raises objection
Tennessee family wins driveway access but loses lawsuit against city over fence permit
stories.summary: A Tennessee family regained access to a shared driveway after a neighbour built a fence through it. A state court later confirmed the family's easement and ordered the fence removed. However, a federal judge dismissed their separate lawsuit against the city, ruling that issuing the building permit did not amount to a government taking.

stories.title: Tribunal Rejects Driveway Claim: UK panel rules out adverse possession bid; driveway’s future use uncertain
stories.summary: In a surprising turn of events, Dr. Piers Connor and Professor Christine Pasquire's quest for ownership of a strip of land has been thwarted. Their claim for legal possession took a hit when the First-tier Tribunal determined they failed to fulfill the adverse possession criteria. Despite using the disputed land since 2017, they couldn't assert their claim owing to not meeting the ten-year occupancy requirement, allowing their neighbors, Dr.

stories.title: 80% of Delhi's pollution Monday due to crackers
Iowa Supreme Court overturns foreclosure after lender failed to notify a co-owner of the default
stories.summary: In a landmark decision, the Iowa Supreme Court determined that Lynae D McMillen Dickey Tesdall, a co-owner of a property, must receive notice before any foreclosure actions can proceed. Despite not signing the promissory note, she was listed as a borrower in the mortgage. While absent, missed payments accumulated, and Wells Fargo neglected to inform her of the ongoing overdue amount.

stories.title: Old Masters Evening Sale: rare Altdorfer oil emerges after decades; expected to fetch up to £5 million
stories.summary: An extraordinary Renaissance masterpiece by Albrecht Altdorfer, estimated at £3 million to £5 million, is set for auction. Having been part of a private Swiss collection since 1957, this painting promises to be a rare find. Prior to the auction, it will grace exhibits in both New York and London, showcasing Altdorfer's revolutionary landscapes that brilliantly emphasize nature's significance in art.

stories.title: Hawaii supreme court to hear elephant habeas corpus plea over sanctuary release
Texas family gets $21.6 million after faulty plumbing makes home unfit to live in
stories.summary: A Texas family has been awarded more than $21.6 million after faulty plumbing sent sewer gas into their home, which they bought in 2018. A plumber later found that the sewer vents ended in the attic. The family reported health problems and had to leave the house, which remains uninhabitable.

stories.title: Generation Be There Campaign: Lady Gaga-backed course tops 100,000 learners; skills boost peer support
stories.summary: Lady Gaga's Born This Way Foundation, collaborating with Jack dot org, has introduced the Be There Certificate programme. This initiative empowers individuals to identify mental health issues and offer necessary support. Since its inception in March 2022, over 100,000 people have successfully completed the complimentary online course. Participants feel more confident in assisting others facing these challenges, promoting a culture of awareness and accountability in mental health welfare.

stories.title: From Babri to Batla House, VHP accuses Sonia of 'selective outrage'
Sinatra's ex-wife Nancy's former Beverly Hills home rents for $27,495 a month
For the first time, Sonia confirms battle with cancer in memoirs
Louisiana court rejects ex-wife’s claim to husband’s Raising Cane’s stake after divorce
stories.summary: Anne McQueen sought to claim business interests from her ex-husband years after their divorce settlement agreement. The Louisiana Court of Appeal upheld the prior ruling, stating property division was already settled in 2007. John's business interests, acquired before marriage, were deemed allocated to him under their consent judgment. The court emphasized that the 2007 agreement waived further claims about community property.

stories.title: South Carolina's 229-acre White Tract to be conserved after 20-year fight against housing development
stories.summary: In a remarkable show of environmental cooperation, a 229-acre tract in South Carolina will transition to permanent conservation after development plans were challenged. Concerns over wetlands, wildlife, and water quality catalyzed a settlement enabling the Open Space Institute to acquire land adjacent to the Cape Romain National Wildlife Refuge. This outcome is a triumph for conservation advocates who have dedicated years to preserve this vital ecological region.

Evening newswrap: Sonia Gandhi's memoir sparks row; India condemns Chinese vloggers; MEA reacts to US midterm results, and more
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi shared her surprise at Pranab Mukherjee's ambition for the prime minister role in 2010. His daughter Sharmishtha questioned the surprise, expressing that such aspirations are valid in politics. India condemned an anti-India campaign by Chinese vloggers in Dhaka, urging the Bangladesh government to act against it. The country also expressed its continued bipartisan support for ties with the US after recent midterm elections.
